blocks.text: The 'Work Order to Return To' is used to transfer the completed inventory, post rework, back to its original workorder, and the same process where the inventory left off. This is not required, if not using this feature, your rework work order may need to include all production steps to complete this WIP or FG product. If returning to the original work order - it must remain active, otherwise you'll not be able to complete the process at the end of this rework.
The first Process in the Selected Process Table below - will be the consuming process for all reworkable inventory you selected. Consumption will be 1:1 standard.
For things like BOM Components, usage, Workcenters/Suppliers you will edit the Work Order after its created in this step.

props.label: Return to Process
props.description: Select the process here - which all selected inventory will be returned to. Once the inventory has been returned to the desired process - you can determine what subsequent steps must be added to the work order - to rework the product.

props.label: Work Order to Return To
props.description: Select the work order you want the inventory to be returned to - once the rework is completed. This is not required, you can only select 1.
